low.title: Full-Day Cluj-Napoca History Route (Low Budget)
low.summary: An affordable full-day history walk through medieval squares, old fortifications, museums and cheap Romanian comfort food.

schedule.title: Piața Unirii History Start
schedule.description: Begin at the main square, observing Gothic St. Michael’s Church and Matthias Corvinus statue.

schedule.title: Old Tailors' Bastion (Exterior)
schedule.description: Walk to the last standing medieval bastion of Cluj’s old defensive walls.

schedule.title: Museum Square Medieval Corners
schedule.description: Explore old narrow streets and view the Franciscan Church exterior.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Cheap Romanian dishes like bean soup, stews, cabbage plates or daily-menu combos.

schedule.title: National History Museum (Exterior Highlights)
schedule.description: Admire the façade and visit only select rooms if you want to stay on a low budget.

schedule.title: Central Park: 19th-Century History
schedule.description: Walk through the historical park and see the Casino building from the 1800s.

schedule.title: Orthodox Cathedral & Avram Iancu Square
schedule.description: See the monumental 20th-century cathedral and surrounding historical architecture.

schedule.title: Old Town Evening Walk
schedule.description: Finish with a relaxed stroll through historic streets, old houses and small courtyards.

schedule.title: Old Tailors’ Bastion

schedule.title: Mid-Range Romanian Lunch
schedule.description: Classic Romanian dishes in a comfortable restaurant.

schedule.title: National Museum of Transylvanian History
schedule.description: Visit curated exhibitions covering medieval and early-modern eras.

schedule.title: Central Park & Casino
schedule.description: Learn about the 19th-century expansion and Austro-Hungarian influence.

schedule.title: Orthodox Cathedral + National Theatre
schedule.description: Historic ensemble representing the 20th-century Romanian identity.

schedule.title: Old Town History Corners
schedule.description: Evening walk through historical façades and calm old streets.
